SWARA INSTITUTE — SHARING THE APP

To email the browser demo:
1. Attach Swara-Institute-Shareable.html to your email.
2. The recipient should download the file, then open it in Chrome or Edge.
3. The app opens with fictional sample students, classes, fees and concerts.
4. The app works offline and requires no installation.

This is a browser demo, not a Windows EXE or an Android installer. It does not
include secure PIN accounts, encrypted storage/backups or Android phone alerts.
Demo changes are saved locally in the browser when browser storage is available.
The shared HTML file contains only app code and generated sample records; it
does not contain records you subsequently edit or save in your browser.
Use Settings to export demo data separately if needed. JSON exports are plain
text and should not contain sensitive institute records.

To install the Android app:
Use Swara-Institute-1.1.apk. Upload it to your cloud drive and share a download
link, or copy the APK to the phone by USB. Open it from Files on Android and
complete the installation prompts. See INSTALL.md for the complete guide.

Gmail blocks .apk and .exe attachments, including those inside archives.
An HTML app is a separate browser version and contains no embedded installer.
Email providers may apply additional attachment filtering; if an HTML file is
rejected, use a cloud-drive download link rather than changing its extension.

Gmail reference: https://support.google.com/mail/answer/6590?hl=en
